response.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaTypeName, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_media) SELECT p.MediaTypeName, p.AvgBytesPerMs AS AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS DiffFromOverall FROM per_media p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg;
